locate.title: Telling 999 where you are
locate.text: Smartphones usually send your location to 999 automatically when you call. Out in the lanes or fields, the what3words app gives three words for your exact 3-metre square, and most UK emergency services accept them. Can't speak on the phone? Register for emergencySMS so you can text 999.
